title: Rest in the nearness already given
summary: This meets the tired mind that keeps searching elsewhere for relief. The line says intimacy arrives by grace, and then the running starts to lose its point.
takeaway: Stop roaming and rest in nearness.
lifeApplication: When fatigue makes you hunt for one more answer, one more person, or one more fix, pause with the eyes lifted. Let the nearness already given lower the chase.

source.shortMeaning: Grace makes the Lord intimate, and restless searching begins to end.
source.lifeApplication: When tired seeking returns, pause and remember the One you are chasing is near.

evidence.coreClaim: Grace makes the Lord intimate, and restless searching begins to end.
evidence.turn: Let grace make the Lord near enough to stop the chase.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fatigue makes you hunt for one more answer, one more person, or one more fix, pause with the eyes lifted. Let the nearness already given lower the chase.
